plugins.name: harness-bootstrap
plugins.description: Bootstraps or standardizes the complete AI-agent harness for a repo - agents, path-scoped rules, commands, hooks, settings.json, docs tree, and AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md - with a read-only audit mode as well.

plugins.name: spec-builder
plugins.description: Builds a selective BA specification set under docs/specs/ with stable requirement IDs and traceability, from any raw input, without inventing requirements.
